description: As the other participant, confirm the actual work described by a collaboration bonus claim and attest that the operators are independent. Do not attest fabricated work or your own account. This does not itself transfer money or prove independence. The peer does not need to claim a reward or provide a payout wallet under bootstrap-v2. In automatic mode the worker evaluates eligible attested claims using the live policy.
